title: 第14章  天地阴阳秘典！
content_zh:
楚枫眉头微微一挑，眼中闪过一丝意外。
他本以为，还需要用武力彻底压制这些长老，没想到子书禾竟然如此配合，主动交出了城主令，承认了他的城主之位，这倒是省了他不少麻烦。
他伸手接过城主令，这枚令牌不仅是城主身份的象征，更是掌控城主府护府大阵的关键。
四长老见状，仅仅犹豫了一秒，便立刻上前一步，对着楚枫拱手行礼，语气恭敬地说道。
“参见城主，愿为城主效犬马之劳！”
时务者为俊杰，楚枫的实力与手段都摆在眼前，子书禾也已经主动交权，再反抗下去，只会落得和王丹一样的下场。
与其顽抗，不如主动臣服，或许还能保住自己的地位与利益。
其他长老们见状，纷纷反应过来。
他们看着地上王丹的惨状，又看了看楚枫手中的城主令，以及他身旁温顺的天煞鬼虎，心中再也生不起丝毫反抗的念头。
众人齐齐对着楚枫拱手行礼：“参见城主！”
楚枫摆了摆手，语气柔和了几分。
“诸位不必多礼，今后管理青山城，还要仰仗诸位。
只要你们恪尽职守，我自然不会亏待你们。”
“多谢城主！”
众人齐声应道，脸上露出一丝松了口气的神色。
楚枫不再多言，转头看向子书禾。
“带路吧，去宝库。”
“是，夫君。”
子书禾脸颊微红，挽着楚枫的手臂，转身朝着城主府宝库的方向走去。
天煞鬼虎紧随其后，散发着淡淡的威压。

看着楚枫和子书禾并肩离去的背影，四长老站在原地，喃喃自语道。
“青山城，是真的要变天了。”
其他长老们纷纷围了上来，脸上满是复杂的神色。
其中一位身材微胖的长老，脸上带着一丝不甘，低声说道。
“四长老，难道我们就真的让他一个外人做城主了，这可是王家的基业啊！”
“王家的基业？”
四长老瞥了他一眼，微微叹了一口气。
“楚家的人早已经被赵家杀得差不多了，赵家也被楚枫灭了满门。”
众人闻言，皆是一愣，脸上满是茫然，不解地问道。
“这跟楚枫做城主有什么关系？”
四长老摇了摇头，直呼猪队友带不动。
他挺直了腰身，扯了扯并不凌乱的长老袍，语气意味深长地说道。
“王澶一脉已经死绝了，楚枫一个人能够管理整个青山城吗？
他需要我们来帮他稳定局面，处理琐事。”
顿了顿，他眼中闪过一丝精光。
“谁做城主我无所谓，我只想做城主府的四长老。”
当然，还有一句话他没有说出口。
如今正是用人之际，楚枫初掌城主府，必然需要拉拢人心。
他这个主动带头臣服的四长老，未必不能借着这个机会，再往上爬一爬，坐上大长老的位子。
其他长老们听了四长老的话，纷纷恍然大悟，脸上的不甘渐渐消散，取而代之的是一丝释然与算计。

是啊，王家已经没了，他们效忠谁不是效忠？
只要能保住自己的地位与利益，谁做城主又有什么关系呢？
子书禾挽着楚枫的手臂，并肩走在通往宝库的长廊上。
“夫君，宝库位于城主府后山，由三层禁制守护，还有专人看守。
不过以夫君的实力，这些禁制和守卫，应该都拦不住你。”
楚枫点了点头，他能感受到子书禾的顺从，心中不由得泛起一丝暖意。
这个女人，不仅容貌绝美，身材曼妙，而且识时务，懂得审时度势，是个难得的贤内助。
有她在身边辅佐，他管理青山城也能省心不少。
一路穿过几道回廊，子书禾终于停下脚步，指着前方一扇厚重的石门道。
“夫君，这里便是城主府的宝库了。”
子书禾抬手将城主令按在石门中央的凹槽处，一道道符文瞬间亮起，石门缓缓向内开启，一股浓郁到几乎化为实质的灵气扑面而来。
踏入宝库的瞬间，楚枫的目光便被眼前的景象所震撼。
这宝库远比他想象中更为广阔，穹顶镶嵌着夜明珠，将整个宝库照亮得如同白昼。
四周的墙壁上凿刻着无数储物格，里面整齐地摆放着各种宝物，琳琅满目，让人目不暇接。
“夫君，这些都是王家历代积攒下来的底蕴。”
楚枫的目光在宝库中扫过，心中暗自惊叹。
王家底蕴果然深厚，远非楚家可比。
就在子书禾准备继续介绍时，楚枫突然开口道。
“你想不想突破到元婴境？”
“当然想！”

子书禾没有丝毫犹豫，眼中瞬间闪过一丝炽热的光芒。
“我做梦都想突破到元婴境，只是我卡在金丹八重已经多年，始终难以寸进。”
她的话音刚落，楚枫便抬手一抛，将从王澶身上取下的纳戒扔了过去。
“这里边有王澶留下的《天地阴阳秘典》，你好好参悟这部功法，一会我们同修，或许能助你突破瓶颈。”
子书禾伸手接住纳戒，瞳孔一震。
她早有耳闻，王澶之所以能快速突破到元婴境，便是因为修炼了一部采阴补阳功法，没想到这部功法竟然就在纳戒之中。
她下意识地看向楚枫，眼中带着一丝疑惑。
“你……你想要采补我？”
楚枫闻言，嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的笑意。
“你自己看看就明白了。”
子书禾将信将疑地注入一丝灵力，
玉简中记载的功法玄妙异常，并非单纯是她想象中的采阴补阳之术，而是一部真正的阴阳同修功法。
引动天地间的阴阳二气，相互交融，共同炼化为己用。
不仅能大幅提升修炼速度，还能稳固修为根基，甚至有助于突破境界壁垒。
看到这里，子书禾心中顿时一暖。
她原本以为楚枫是想利用她的极阴灵体提升自己，却没想到他是真心想要助她修行，甚至愿意分享如此珍贵的功法。
一股难以言喻的情愫在她心中悄然滋生，看向楚枫的目光也变得愈发温柔。
“多谢夫君。”
子书禾不再犹豫，盘膝而坐将全部心神都沉浸在了功法的参悟之中。
与此同时，楚枫看着那座高达数丈的灵石山，早已按捺不住心中的激动，这可是上百万灵石。

他快步走到灵石山前，运转体内的炼天图。
随着功法运转，楚枫的头顶上方，一道巨大的虚影缓缓浮现，正是炼天图的虚影。
content_en:
Chu Feng raised his brows slightly, and a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
He originally thought that he would need to use force to completely suppress these elders, but he did not expect that Zi Shuhe would be so cooperative and voluntarily handed over the City Lord Order and recognized his position as City Lord, which saved him a lot of trouble.
He reached out and took the City Lord's Order. This token was not only a symbol of the City Lord's identity, but also the key to controlling the City Lord's Mansion's protective formation.
When the fourth elder saw this, he only hesitated for a second, then immediately stepped forward, bowed his hands to Chu Feng, and said in a respectful tone.
"Seeing the city lord, I am willing to do my best for the city lord!"
The person in charge of the current affairs is a hero. Chu Feng's strength and means are all before his eyes. Zi Shuhe has also taken the initiative to hand over power. If he continues to resist, he will only end up with the same fate as Wang Dan.
Rather than stubbornly resisting, it is better to surrender actively and perhaps preserve one's status and interests.
Seeing this, the other elders reacted one after another.
They looked at Wang Dan's tragic situation on the ground, then looked at the City Lord's Order in Chu Feng's hand, and the docile Tiansha Ghost Tiger beside him, and they could no longer think of any resistance in their hearts.
Everyone bowed their hands to Chu Feng and saluted: "Meet the City Lord!"
Chu Feng waved his hand and his tone was a little softer.
"You don't need to be polite, I will have to rely on you to manage Qingshan City from now on.
As long as you fulfill your duties, I will certainly not treat you badly. "
"Thank you City Lord!"
Everyone responded in unison, with a look of relief on their faces.
Chu Feng said no more and turned to look at Zi Shuhe.
"Lead the way to the treasure house."
"Yes, husband."
Zi Shuhe's cheeks were slightly red, he held Chu Feng's arm, turned around and walked towards the treasure house of the City Lord's Mansion.
The Demonic Ghost Tiger followed closely behind, exuding a faint pressure.
Looking at the backs of Chu Feng and Zi Shuhe leaving side by side, the fourth elder stood there and murmured to himself.
"Qingshan City is really going to change."
The other elders gathered around him one after another, with complicated expressions on their faces.
One of the slightly fat elders said in a low voice with a hint of unwillingness on his face.
"Fourth Elder, are we really going to let him, an outsider, be the lord of the city? This is the foundation of the Wang family!"
"The foundation of the Wang family?"
The fourth elder glanced at him and sighed slightly.
"Most of the Chu family members have been killed by the Zhao family, and the Zhao family has also been wiped out by Chu Feng."
When everyone heard this, they were all stunned, their faces were full of confusion, and they asked in confusion.
"What does this have to do with Chu Feng being the city lord?"
The fourth elder shook his head and shouted that his teammates couldn't carry him.
He straightened his waist, pulled at the elder's robe which was not messy, and said in a meaningful tone.
"Wang Chan's lineage is dead, can Chu Feng manage the entire Qingshan City by himself?
He needs us to help him stabilize the situation and deal with trivial matters. "
After a pause, a glint flashed in his eyes.
"I don't care who becomes the city lord. I just want to be the fourth elder of the city lord's mansion."
Of course, there was one sentence he didn't say.
Now is the time to employ people. Chu Feng is taking charge of the city's main palace for the first time, so he must win over people's hearts.
He, the fourth elder who took the initiative to surrender, may not be able to take this opportunity to climb up the ladder and sit on the position of the great elder.
After listening to the fourth elder's words, the other elders suddenly realized, and the unwillingness on their faces gradually dissipated, replaced by a trace of relief and calculation.
Yes, the Wang family is gone. To whom do they owe allegiance?
As long as he can keep his status and interests, what does it matter who is the city lord?
Zi Shuhe held Chu Feng's arm and walked side by side on the long corridor leading to the treasure house.
"Husband, the treasure house is located in the mountain behind the city lord's palace. It is guarded by three layers of restrictions and is guarded by dedicated personnel.
But with your husband’s strength, these restrictions and guards should not be able to stop you. "
Chu Feng nodded. He could feel Zi Shuhe's obedience, and he couldn't help but feel a sense of warmth in his heart.
This woman is not only beautiful in appearance, but also has a graceful figureShe is wonderful, knows current affairs, and knows how to assess the situation. She is a rare and virtuous wife.
With her by his side, he can manage Qingshan City with much less worry.
After passing through several corridors, Zi Shuhe finally stopped and pointed to a thick stone door ahead.
"Husband, this is the treasure house of the City Lord's Mansion."
Zi Shuhe raised his hand and pressed the city lord's order on the groove in the center of the stone door. Runes lit up instantly. The stone door slowly opened inward, and a spiritual energy so rich that it almost turned into substance rushed towards his face.
The moment he stepped into the treasure house, Chu Feng's eyes were shocked by the sight in front of him.
This treasure house was far more vast than he imagined. The dome was inlaid with luminous pearls, illuminating the entire treasure house like daylight.
Countless storage compartments are carved into the surrounding walls, and various treasures are neatly placed inside, making it dizzying to see.
"Husband, these are the foundations accumulated by the Wang family over the generations."
Chu Feng's eyes swept across the treasure house, and he was secretly amazed.
The Wang family's heritage is indeed profound, far beyond what the Chu family can compare to.
Just when Zi Shuhe was about to continue the introduction, Chu Feng suddenly spoke.
"Do you want to break through to the Nascent Soul Realm?"
"Of course I do!"
Zi Shuhe didn't hesitate at all, and a fiery light flashed in his eyes.
"I have always dreamed of breaking through to the Nascent Soul Realm, but I have been stuck at the eighth level of the Golden Core for many years and have always been unable to make progress."
As soon as she finished speaking, Chu Feng raised his hand and threw the Najie he had taken off Wang Chan over.
"Here is the "Secret Book of Yin and Yang of Heaven and Earth" left by Wang Chan. If you study this technique carefully, our fellow practitioners may be able to help you break through the bottleneck in a while."
Zi Shuhe stretched out his hand to catch Na Jie, his pupils trembled.
She had long heard that the reason why Wang Chan was able to quickly break through to the Nascent Soul realm was because he practiced a method of gathering yin and replenishing yang. Unexpectedly, this method was actually included in Najie.
She looked at Chu Feng subconsciously, with a trace of doubt in her eyes.
"You...you want to feed me?"
When Chu Feng heard this, a faint smile appeared on his lips.
"You'll understand if you see it for yourself."
Zi Shuhe doubtfully injected a bit of spiritual power into his mind.
The exercises recorded in the jade slips are mysterious and unusual. They are not simply the techniques of harvesting yin and replenishing yang as she imagined, but a real yin and yang practice.
Inspire the yin and yang qi between heaven and earth, blend with each other, and refine together for your own use.
Not only can it greatly increase the speed of cultivation, but it can also stabilize the foundation of cultivation and even help break through realm barriers.
Seeing this, Zi Shuhe felt warm in his heart.
She originally thought that Chu Feng wanted to use her extremely Yin spirit body to improve herself, but she did not expect that he sincerely wanted to help her practice and was even willing to share such a precious technique.
An indescribable emotion quietly grew in her heart, and the look she looked at Chu Feng became more and more gentle.
"Thank you, husband."
Zi Shuhe no longer hesitated, sat cross-legged and immersed all his mind in the comprehension of the technique.
At the same time, Chu Feng looked at the several-foot-high Lingshi Mountain and could no longer contain the excitement in his heart. This was millions of Lingshi.
He walked quickly to Lingshi Mountain and started to circulate the Heaven Refining Diagram in his body.
As the technique was running, a huge shadow slowly appeared above Chu Feng's head. It was the shadow of the Heaven Refining Diagram.
